title: Causal Long-History Target Memory and Climatology Feature Store
mission: Exploit the 1884+ HKO target record through strictly available lags, causal climatology, trends, volatility and spell-state features.
steps: Determine earliest label date available at each cutoff; do not assume T−1.
Create explicit lag and lagged rolling windows with availability-safe offsets.
Create causal day-of-year, harmonic, decayed and trend-adjusted climatologies fitted on prior years only.
Create 7/30/60-day slopes, curvature, range, volatility, MAD/IQR, spell duration, breakout, reversal and year-over-year analog features.
Version feature formulas and effective history counts.
Create long-history target-memory expert-ready matrices independent of modern NWP.
acceptance: Every feature uses labels provably available
failure: Publication timing unresolved: enforce conservative approved lag and flag
